changes: New in-house catalog items with defined scope caps: Light Switch Replacement, Outlet Replacement, Ceiling Fan Replacement/Install, Curtain Rod Install, Small Light Fixture Replacement, TV Mount Removal & Patch, Carpet Removal & Haul.

Packages layer: 11 bundle packages grouped by tier in a new repair_packages table, selectable in the checklist step (auto-checks underlying items), applies a marketed discount computed server-side on POST /api/repair-consult/:id/items.
Sign-today free-item incentive (repair_incentive_settings: threshold + free item), computed alongside the discount and surfaced on the Review step totals card and on the client-facing quote PDF.

Quote generation and vendor dispatch now auto-fire once the Review step is reached (no more double-tap) — the Office Approval Gate for the client-facing send is unchanged and still requires an explicit tap.
Skips the redundant whole-home gallery step when nested from Listing Consult and photos already exist; gallery URLs now flow from ListingConsultSheet -> AgentView -> RepairConsultSheet.

Standalone Repair Consult creation now auto-fetches a Google Street View front-of-house photo as the default hero photo (no-ops safely without GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY); any manual hero upload always wins and is tagged hero_photo_source='manual' so it is never overwritten.

Bugfix: quote PDF generation was throwing a 500 (WinAnsi cannot encode U+2713) whenever a sign-today free-item incentive was applied, because the checkmark glyph in the free-item PDF line is not in pdf-lib default Helvetica WinAnsi encoding. Replaced the unicode checkmark with a plain "FREE:" text prefix.
bundleMustContain: Reused the walkthrough photos already captured during Listing Consult
__bundleNotes: New catalog item names (Ceiling Fan Replacement/Install, Curtain Rod Install, etc.) are server-provided data fetched at runtime, not string literals in the client bundle — verified via mathChecks against the live /api/repair-items payload instead of bundle substring matching, per the v20.7.53 manifest gotcha about server-provided values. v20.18.1 also fixes a server-side PDF generation crash (WinAnsi checkmark encoding) found via a live functional smoke test (package select + items post + generate-quote) against a disposable TEST-DELETE-ME consult on the v20.18.0 deploy — verified manually via curl, not re-encoded as an automated mathCheck since generate-quote returns a binary PDF stream rather than JSON.
